You suggest a course of activity (limited to a sentence or two) and magically influence a creature you can see within range that can hear and understand you. Creatures that can't be charmed are immune to this effect. The suggestion must be worded in such a manner as to make the course of action sound reasonable. Asking the creature to stab itself, throw itself onto a spear, immolate itself, or do some other obviously harmful act ends the spell.

The target must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, it pursues the course of action you described to the best of its ability. The suggested course of action can continue for the entire duration. If the suggested activity can be completed in a shorter time, the spell ends when the subject finishes what it was asked to do.

You can also specify conditions that will trigger a special activity during the duration. For example, you might suggest that a knight give her warhorse to the first beggar she meets. If the condition isn't met before the spell expires, the activity isn't performed.

If you or any of your companions damage the target, the spell ends.
Suggestion.materials: A snake's tongue and either a bit of honeycomb or a drop of sweet oil

Dominate Person.name: Dominate Person
Dominate Person.description:
You attempt to beguile a humanoid that you can see within range. It must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be charmed by you for the duration. If you or creatures that are friendly to you are fighting it, it has advantage on the saving throw.

While the target is charmed, you have a telepathic link with it as long as the two of you are on the same plane of existence. You can use this telepathic link to issue commands to the creature while you are conscious (no action required), which it does its best to obey. You can specify a simple and general course of action, such as "Attack that creature," "Run over there," or "Fetch that object." If the creature completes the order and doesn't receive further direction from you, it defends and preserves itself to the best of its ability.

You can use your action to take total and precise control of the target. Until the end of your next turn, the creature takes only the actions you choose, and doesn't do anything that you don't allow it to do. During this time you can also cause the creature to use a reaction, but this requires you to use your own reaction as well.

Each time the target takes damage, it makes a new Wisdom saving throw against the spell. If the saving throw succeeds, the spell ends.

At Higher Levels. When you cast this spell using a 6th-level spell slot, the duration is concentration, up to 10 minutes. When you use a 7th-level spell slot, the duration is concentration, up to 1 hour. When you use a spell slot of 8th level or higher, the duration is concentration, up to 8 hours.

At Higher Levels. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, you can target one additional creature for each slot level above 3rd.

Plane Shift.name: Plane Shift
Plane Shift.description:
You and up to eight willing creatures who link hands in a circle are transported to a different plane of existence. You can specify a target destination in general terms, such as the City of Brass on the Elemental Plane of Fire or the palace of Dispater on the second level of the Nine Hells, and you appear in or near that destination. If you are trying to reach the City of Brass, for example, you might arrive in its Street of Steel, before its Gate of Ashes, or looking at the city from across the Sea of Fire, at the DM's discretion.

Alternatively, if you know the sigil sequence of a teleportation circle on another plane of existence, this spell can take you to that circle. If the teleportation circle is too small to hold all the creatures you transported, they appear in the closest unoccupied spaces next to the circle.

You can use this spell to banish an unwilling creature to another plane. Choose a creature within your reach and make a melee spell attack against it. On a hit, the creature must make a Charisma saving throw. If the creature fails this save, it is transported to a random location on the plane of existence you specify. A creature so transported must find its own way back to your current plane of existence.
Plane Shift.materials: A forked, metal rod worth at least 250 gp, attuned to a particular plane of existence

Amorphous.description: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without &reference[squeezing]{Squeezing}.

Shadow Stealth.name: Shadow Stealth
Shadow Stealth.description: While in &reference[dim light] or &reference[darkness], the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can take the &reference[Hide] action as a bonus action.
Shadow Stealth.chat: The shadow can take the Hide action as a bonus action.

Hide.name: Hide
Hide.condition: While the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} is in &reference[dim light] or &reference[darkness].

Strength Drain.name: Strength Drain
Strength Drain.description:
[[/attack extended]]. [[/damage extended]].

The target's Strength score is reduced by [[/r 1d4]]. The target dies if this reduces its Strength to 0. Otherwise, the reduction lasts until the target finishes a short or long rest. If a non-evil humanoid dies from this attack, a new @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.monsters.Actor.QGcQYZbVl4bWzi4E]{shadow} rises from the corpse 1d4 hours later.

Raise Shadow.name: Raise Shadow
Raise Shadow.condition: When a non-evil humanoid dies from this attack.

Strength Drain: 1.name: Strength Drain: 1
Strength Drain: 1.description: Your Strength score is reduced by 1. You die if this reduces your Strength to 0. Otherwise, the reductions lasts until you finish a short or long rest.

Strength Drain: 2.name: Strength Drain: 2
Strength Drain: 2.description: Your Strength score is reduced by 2. You die if this reduces your Strength to 0. Otherwise, the reductions lasts until you finish a short or long rest.

Strength Drain: 3.name: Strength Drain: 3
Strength Drain: 3.description: Your Strength score is reduced by 3. You die if this reduces your Strength to 0. Otherwise, the reductions lasts until you finish a short or long rest.

Strength Drain: 4.name: Strength Drain: 4
Strength Drain: 4.description: Your Strength score is reduced by 4. You die if this reduces your Strength to 0. Otherwise, the reductions lasts until you finish a short or long rest.

Sunlight Sensitivity.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
Sunlight Sensitivity.description: While in sunlight, the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

Lightning Absorption.name: Lightning Absorption
Lightning Absorption.description: Whenever the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} is subjected to lightning damage, it takes no damage and regains a number of hit points equal to the lightning damage dealt.

Regain Hit Points.name: Regain Hit Points
Regain Hit Points.condition: Whenever the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} is subjected to lightning damage.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} makes two [[/item .lOIA9YKQU8xSx7Lj]]{slam} attacks. If both attacks hit a Medium or smaller target, the target is &reference[grappled] escape DC 14, and the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} uses its [[/item .N42BQALoCmeYphD1]]{Engulf} on it.

Engulf.name: Engulf
Engulf.description:
The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} engulfs a Medium or smaller creature &reference[grappled apply=false] by it. The engulfed target is &reference[blinded], &reference[restrained], and unable to breathe, and it must succeed on a [[/save activity=qxYtQIpEbpMrFvVe]] saving throw at the start of each of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s turns or take [[/damage average activity=qxYtQIpEbpMrFvVe]] damage.

If the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} moves, the engulfed target moves with it. The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can have only one creature engulfed at a time.
Engulf.chat: The [[lookup @name]]{monster} engulfs a Medium or smaller creature &reference[grappled apply=false] by it. The engulfed target is &reference[blinded ], &reference[restrained], and unable to breathe, and it must make a Constitution saving throw at the start of each of the [[lookup @name]]{monster}'s turns. If the [[lookup @name]]{monster} moves, the engulfed target moves with it.

Engulfed.name: Engulfed
Engulfed.description:
You have been engulfed by the shambling mound. You are &reference[blinded apply=false], &reference[restrained apply=false], and unable to breathe, and you must succeed on a Constitution saving throw at the start of each of the shambling mound's turns or take bludgeoning damage/

If the shambling mound moves, you move with it.

Shield Guardian.name: Shield Guardian
Shield Guardian.languages: understands commands given in any language but can't speak

Bound.name: Bound
Bound.description: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} is magically bound to an amulet. As long as the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} and its amulet are on the same plane of existence, the amulet's wearer can telepathically call the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} to travel to it, and the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} knows the distance and direction to the amulet. If the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} is within 60 feet of the amulet's wearer, half of any damage the wearer takes (rounded up) is transferred to the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}.
Bound.chat: The shield guardian is magically bound to an amulet.

Regeneration.name: Regeneration
Regeneration.description: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} regains [[/healing]] at the start of its turn if it has at least 1 hit point.
Regeneration.chat: The shield guardian regains 10 hit points at the start of its turn.

Spell Storing.name: Spell Storing
Spell Storing.description:
A spellcaster who wears the shield [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s amulet can cause the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} to store one spell of 4th level or lower. To do so, the wearer must cast the spell on the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}. The spell has no effect but is stored within the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}. When commanded to do so by the wearer or when a situation arises that was predefined by the spellcaster, the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} casts the stored spell with any parameters set by the original caster, requiring no components. When the spell is cast or a new spell is stored, any previously stored spell is lost.

Foundry Note

Add a spell into the Cast activity on this feature to allow the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} to caster the spell. Remove the spell from the activity afterwards.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} makes two [[/item .r6GQ1TwNK7pinX0a]]{fist} attacks.

Shield.name: Shield
Shield.description: When a creature makes an attack against the wearer of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s amulet, the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} grants a +2 bonus to the wearer's AC if the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} is within 5 feet of the wearer.

Guard Amulet Bearer.name: Guard Amulet Bearer
Guard Amulet Bearer.condition: When a creature makes an attack against the wearer of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s amulet.

Shriek.name: Shriek
Shriek.description: When &reference[bright light] or a creature is within [[lookup @labels.description.range activity=jlIOy920hBT6hxVd]] of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}, it emits a shriek audible within 300 feet of it. The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} continues to shriek until the disturbance moves out of range and for 1d4 of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s turns afterward.
Shriek.chat: When &reference[bright light] or a creature is within [[lookup @labels.description.range activity=jlIOy920hBT6hxVd]] of the [[lookup @name]]{monster}, it emits a shriek audible within 300 feet of it.

Emit Shriek.name: Emit Shriek
Emit Shriek.condition: When &reference[bright light] or a creature is within 30 feet of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}.

False Appearance.name: False Appearance
False Appearance.description: While the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from an ordinary fungus.

Breath Weapons.name: Breath Weapons
Breath Weapons.description:
The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} uses one of the following breath weapons.

Cold Breath. The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} exhales an icy blast in a [[lookup @labels.description.template activity=9gMvqjbgKK42uyzr]]. Each creature in that area must make a [[/save activity=U5F5qe2Hu0r0yHmk]] saving throw, taking [[/damage average activity=U5F5qe2Hu0r0yHmk]] damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

Paralyzing Breath. The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} exhales paralyzing gas in a [[lookup @labels.description.template activity=9gMvqjbgKK42uyzr]]. Each creature in that area must succeed on a [[/save activity=9gMvqjbgKK42uyzr]] saving throw or be paralyzed for [[lookup @labels.duration activity=9gMvqjbgKK42uyzr]]. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

Paralyzing Breath.name: Paralyzing Breath
Paralyzing Breath.description: You are &reference[paralyzed apply=false] for 1 minute. You can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of your turns, ending the effect on yourself.

Skeleton.name: Skeleton
Skeleton.languages: Understands all languages it knew in life but can't speak

Flying Sword.name: Flying Sword
Flying Sword.description:
The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} releases its greatsword to hover magically in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of it. If the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can see the sword, the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can mentally command it as a bonus action to fly up to 50 feet and either make one attack against a target or return to the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s hands. If the hovering sword is targeted by any effect, the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} is considered to be holding it. The hovering sword falls if the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} dies.

Foundry Note

Enchant the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} greatsword using the activity on this feature, granting it a "Command Sword" activity that can be used as a bonus action.
Flying Sword.chat: The solar releases its greatsword to hover magically in an unoccupied space within 5 ft. of it. If the hovering sword is targeted by any effect, the solar is considered to be holding it.

Innate Spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
Innate Spellcasting.description:
The solar's spell casting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 25). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

At will: [[/item .Mzh95utKDPIrjiH8]]{detect evil and good}, [[/item .1N8dDMMgZ1h1YJ3B]]{invisibility} (self only)

3/day each: [[/item .dLJhxDfeyOsc3zsY]]{blade barrier}, [[/item .TkJ8Wtg1L7TZtspm]]{dispel evil and good}, [[/item .jhhT9PsHy5A7EojO]]{resurrection}

1/day each: [[/item .d54VDyFulD9xxY7J]]{commune}, [[/item .ZPd73HtKF3At11jh]]{control weather}

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} makes two [[/item .QssrfCioglFdfd8I]]{greatsword} attacks.

Slaying Longbow.name: Slaying Longbow
Slaying Longbow.description:
[[/attack extended]]. [[/damage extended]].

If the target is a creature that has 100 hit points or fewer, it must succeed on a [[/save]] saving throw or die.
Slaying Longbow.chat: The [[lookup @name]]{monster} attacks with its [[lookup @item.name]]. If the target is a creature that has 100 hit points or fewer, it must make a Constitution saving throw.

Slaying Save.name: Slaying Save
Slaying Save.condition: When a creature that has 100 hit points or fewer is hit by this attack.

Teleport.name: Teleport
Teleport.description: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} magically teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, up to [[lookup @labels.description.range activity=ceqRWRMK1a37epib]] to an unoccupied space it can see.

Searing Burst.name: Searing Burst
Searing Burst.description: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} emits magical, divine energy. Each creature of its choice in a [[lookup @labels.description.template activity=QE8HFlW0jsWaWwdx]] must make a [[/save]] saving throw, taking [[/damage average]] damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
Searing Burst.chat: The solar emits magical, divine energy. Each creature of its choice in a [[lookup @labels.description.template activity=QE8HFlW0jsWaWwdx]] must make a Dexterity saving throw.

Blinding Gaze.name: Blinding Gaze
Blinding Gaze.description: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} targets [[lookup @labels.description.affects activity=fOKbYw2p3tXhOyn2]] it can see within [[lookup @labels.description.range activity=fOKbYw2p3tXhOyn2]] of it. If the target can see it, the target must succeed on a [[/save]] saving throw or be &Reference[blinded apply=false] until magic such as @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells.Item.F0GsG0SJzsIOacwV]{Lesser Restoration} spell removes the blindness.
Blinding Gaze.chat: The solar targets one creature it can see within 30 feet of it. If the target can see it, the target must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or be blinded.

Blinded.name: Blinded
Blinded.description:
The target is blinded until magic such as the lesser restoration spell removes the blindness.

You are &reference[blinded apply=false] until magic such as @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells.Item.F0GsG0SJzsIOacwV]{Lesser Restoration} spell removes the blindness.

Detect Evil and Good.name: Detect Evil and Good
Detect Evil and Good.description:
For the duration, you know if there is an aberration, celestial, elemental, fey, fiend, or undead within 30 feet of you, as well as where the creature is located. Similarly, you know if there is a place or object within 30 feet of you that has been magically consecrated or desecrated.

The spell can penetrate most barriers, but it is blocked by 1 foot of stone, 1 inch of common metal, a thin sheet of lead, or 3 feet of wood or dirt.

Invisibility.name: Invisibility
Invisibility.description:
A creature you touch becomes invisible until the spell ends. Anything the target is wearing or carrying is invisible as long as it is on the target's person. The spell ends for a target that attacks or casts a spell.

At Higher Levels. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, you can target one additional creature for each slot level above 2nd.
Invisibility.materials: An eyelash encased in gum arabic

Blade Barrier.name: Blade Barrier
Blade Barrier.description:
You create a vertical wall of whirling, razor-sharp blades made of magical energy. The wall appears within range and lasts for the duration. You can make a straight wall up to 100 feet long, 20 feet high, and 5 feet thick, or a ringed wall up to 60 feet in diameter, 20 feet high, and 5 feet thick. The wall provides three-quarters cover to creatures behind it, and its space is difficult terrain.

When a creature enters the wall's area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there, the creature must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 6d10 slashing damage. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage.

Dispel Evil and Good.name: Dispel Evil and Good
Dispel Evil and Good.description:
Shimmering energy surrounds and protects you from fey, Undead, and creatures originating from Beyond the Material Plane. For the Duration, Celestials, Elementals, fey, Fiends, and undead have disadvantage on Attack rolls against you.

You can end the spell early by using either of the following special functions.

Break Enchantment. As your action, you touch a creature you can reach that is Charmed, Frightened, or possessed by a Celestial, an elemental, a fey, a fiend, or an Undead. The creature you touch is no longer charmed, frightened, or possessed by such creatures.

Dismissal. As your action, make a melee spell Attack against a Celestial, an elemental, a fey, a fiend, or an Undead you can reach. On a hit, you attempt to drive the creature back to its home plane. The creature must succeed on a Charisma saving throw or be sent back to its home plane (if it isn't there already). If they aren't on their home plane, undead are sent to the Shadowfell, and fey are sent to the Feywild.
Dispel Evil and Good.materials: Holy water or powdered silver and iron

Resurrection.name: Resurrection
Resurrection.description:
You touch a dead creature that has been dead for no more than a century, that didn't die of old age, and that isn't undead. If its soul is free and willing, the target returns to life with all its hit points.

This spell neutralizes any poisons and cures normal diseases afflicting the creature when it died. It doesn't, however, remove magical diseases, curses, and the like; if such effects aren't removed prior to casting the spell, they afflict the target on its return to life.

This spell closes all mortal wounds and restores any missing body parts.

Coming back from the dead is an ordeal. The target takes a −4 penalty to all attack rolls, saving throws, and ability checks. Every time the target finishes a long rest, the penalty is reduced by 1 until it disappears.

Casting this spell to restore life to a creature that has been dead for one year or longer taxes you greatly. Until you finish a long rest, you can't cast spells again, and you have disadvantage on all attack rolls, ability checks, and saving throws.
Resurrection.materials: A diamond worth at least 1,000 gp, which the spell consumes

Commune.name: Commune
Commune.description:
You contact your deity or a divine proxy and ask up to three questions that can be answered with a yes or no. You must ask your questions before the spell ends. You receive a correct answer for each question.

Divine beings aren't necessarily omniscient, so you might receive "unclear" as an answer if a question pertains to information that lies beyond the deity's knowledge. In a case where a one-word answer could be misleading or contrary to the deity's interests, the DM might offer a short phrase as an answer instead.

If you cast the spell two or more times before finishing your next long rest, there is a cumulative 25 percent chance for each casting after the first that you get no answer. The DM makes this roll in secret.
Commune.materials: Incense and a vial of holy or unholy water

Control Weather.name: Control Weather
Control Weather.description:
You take control of the weather within 5 miles of you for the duration. You must be outdoors to cast this spell. Moving to a place where you don't have a clear path to the sky ends the spell early.

When you cast the spell, you change the current weather conditions, which are determined by the DM based on the climate and season. You can change precipitation, temperature, and wind. It takes 1d4 x 10 minutes for the new conditions to take effect. Once they do so, you can change the conditions again. When the spell ends, the weather gradually returns to normal.

When you change the weather conditions, find a current condition on the following tables and change its stage by one, up or down. When changing the wind, you can change its direction.

Conditions

  1. Clear
  2. Light clouds
  3. Overcast or ground fog
  4. Rain, hail, or snow
  5. Torrential rain, driving hail, or blizzard

Temperature

  1. Unbearable heat
  2. Hot
  3. Warm
  4. Cool
  5. Cold
  6. Arctic cold

Wind

  1. Calm
  2. Moderate wind
  3. Strong wind
  4. Gale
  5. Storm
Control Weather.materials: Burning incense and bits of earth and wood mixed in water.

Divine Awareness.name: Divine Awareness
Divine Awareness.description: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} knows if it hears a lie.

Angelic Weapons.name: Angelic Weapons
Angelic Weapons.description: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s weapon attacks are magical. When the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra 6d8 radiant damage (included in the attack).
Angelic Weapons.chat: The planetar's weapon attacks are magical. When the planetar hits with any weapon, the weapon deals extra radiant damage (included in the attack).

Magic Resistance.name: Magic Resistance
Magic Resistance.description: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

Healing Touch.name: Healing Touch
Healing Touch.description: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} touches another creature. The target magically regains [[/heal average]] and is freed from any curse, disease, poison, &reference[blinded apply=false]{Blindness}, or &reference[deafened apply=false]{Deafness}.

Specter.name: Specter
Specter.languages: Understands all languages it knew in life but can't speak

Incorporeal Movement.name: Incorporeal Movement
Incorporeal Movement.description:
The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can move through other creatures and objects as if they were &reference[difficult terrain].

It takes [[/damage average]] damage if it ends its turn inside an object.
Incorporeal Movement.chat: The [[lookup @name]]{monster} can move through other creatures and objects as if they were &reference[difficult terrain].

End Turn in Object Damage.name: End Turn in Object Damage
End Turn in Object Damage.condition: When the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} ends their turn inside an object.

Incorporeal Movement.name: Incorporeal Movement
Incorporeal Movement.description: You can move through other creatures and objects as if they were &reference[difficult terrain].

Sunlight Sensitivity.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
Sunlight Sensitivity.description: While in sunlight, the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

Life Drain.name: Life Drain
Life Drain.description:
[[/attack extended]]. [[/damage extended]].

The target must succeed on a [[/save]] saving throw or its hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the damage taken. This reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target dies if this effect reduces its hit point maximum to 0.
Life Drain.chat: The [[lookup @name]]{monster} attacks with its [[lookup @item.name]]. The target must make a Constitution saving throw.

Drain Maximum Hit Point Save.name: Drain Maximum Hit Point Save
Drain Maximum Hit Point Save.condition: When a creature is hit by this attack.

Spider Climb.name: Spider Climb
Spider Climb.description: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

Bite.name: Bite
Bite.description:
[[/attack extended]]. [[/damage extended]].

The target must succeed on a [[/save]] saving throw or take [[/damage average activity=gJp39jB1DO0Q5LPK]] damage.
Bite.chat: The [[lookup @name]]{monster} attacks with its [[lookup @item.name]]. The target must make a Constitution saving throw.

Web Sense.name: Web Sense
Web Sense.description: While in contact with a web, the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} knows the exact location of any other creature in contact with the same web.

Web Walker.name: Web Walker
Web Walker.description: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} ignores movement restrictions caused by webbing.

Bite.name: Bite
Bite.description:
[[/attack extended]]. [[/damage extended]].

The target must make a [[/save activity=q1kzQBmcMwK6GGVz]] saving throw, taking [[/damage average activity=q1kzQBmcMwK6GGVz]] damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
Bite.chat: The [[lookup @name]]{monster} attacks with its [[lookup @item.name]]. The target must make a Constitution saving throw.

Poison Save.name: Poison Save
Poison Save.condition: When a creature is hit by this attack.

Spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
Spellcasting.description:
The naga is a 10th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 14, +6 to hit with spell attacks), and it needs only verbal components to cast its spells. It has the following wizard spells prepared:

Cantrips (at will): [[/item .Utk1OQRwYkMkFRD3]]{mage hand}, [[/item .oIzA2MEHwxhtQneU]]{minor illusion}, [[/item .ctW81uiX56xZR2c5]]{ray of frost}

1st level (4 slots): [[/item .eS7XnnApoxRxYXPs]]{charm person}, [[/item .ghXTfe7sgCbgf1Q8]]{detect magic}, [[/item .KhwiSi9fwVfUPtku]]{sleep}

2nd level (3 slots): [[/item .ppWAAEul0QHtm4er]]{detect thoughts}, [[/item .3Lo9boi7P2ro6QV4]]{hold person}

3rd level (3 slots): [[/item .IyikgTEOTv701jgQ]]{lightning bolt}, [[/item .13uVuBQP6VaiSPvC]]{water breathing}

4th level (3 slots): [[/item .pybg5MNc3lkerH4Y]]{blight}, [[/item .A4RsPuSvB9wFtz1j]]{dimension door}

5th level (2 slots): [[/item .91Sw6vOIaO7U8DvM]]{dominate person}
Spellcasting.chat: The naga is a spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Intelligence and it needs only verbal components to cast its spells.

Mage Hand.name: Mage Hand
Mage Hand.description:
A spectral, floating hand appears at a point you choose within range. The hand lasts for the duration or until you dismiss it as an action. The hand vanishes if it is ever more than 30 feet away from you or if you cast this spell again.

You can use your action to control the hand. You can use the hand to manipulate an object, open an unlocked door or container, stow or retrieve an item from an open container, or pour the contents out of a vial. You can move the hand up to 30 feet each time you use it.

The hand can't attack, activate magic items, or carry more than 10 pounds.

Minor Illusion.name: Minor Illusion
Minor Illusion.description:
You create a sound or an image of an object within range that lasts for the duration. The illusion also ends if you dismiss it as an action or cast this spell again.

If you create a sound, its volume can range from a whisper to a scream. It can be your voice, someone else's voice, a lion's roar, a beating of drums, or any other sound you choose. The sound continues unabated throughout the duration, or you can make discrete sounds at different times before the spell ends.

If you create an image of an object—such as a chair, muddy footprints, or a small chest—it must be no larger than a 5-foot cube. The image can't create sound, light, smell, or any other sensory effect. Physical interaction with the image reveals it to be an illusion, because things can pass through it.

If a creature uses its action to examine the sound or image, the creature can determine that it is an illusion with a successful Intelligence (Investigation) check against your spell save DC. If a creature discerns the illusion for what it is, the illusion becomes faint to the creature.

Ray of Frost.name: Ray of Frost
Ray of Frost.description:
A frigid beam of blue-white light streaks toward a creature within range. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, it takes 1d8 cold damage, and its speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of your next turn.

The spell's damage increases by 1d8 when you reach 5th level (2d8), 11th level (3d8), and 17th level (4d8).

Charm Person.name: Charm Person
Charm Person.description:
You attempt to charm a humanoid you can see within range. It must make a Wisdom saving throw, and does so with advantage if you or your companions are fighting it. If it fails the saving throw, it is charmed by you until the spell ends or until you or your companions do anything harmful to it. The charmed creature regards you as a friendly acquaintance. When the spell ends, the creature knows it was charmed by you.

At Higher Levels. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, you can target one additional creature for each slot level above 1st. The creatures must be within 30 feet of each other when you target them.

Detect Magic.name: Detect Magic
Detect Magic.description:
For the duration, you sense the presence of magic within 30 feet of you. If you sense magic in this way, you can use your action to see a faint aura around any visible creature or object in the area that bears magic, and you learn its school of magic, if any.

The spell can penetrate most barriers, but it is blocked by 1 foot of stone, 1 inch of common metal, a thin sheet of lead, or 3 feet of wood or dirt.

Sleep.name: Sleep
Sleep.description:
This spell sends creatures into a magical slumber. Roll 5d8; the total is how many hit points of creatures this spell can affect. Creatures within 20 feet of a point you choose within range are affected in ascending order of their current hit points (ignoring unconscious creatures).

Starting with the creature that has the lowest current hit points, each creature affected by this spell falls unconscious until the spell ends, the sleeper takes damage, or someone uses an action to shake or slap the sleeper awake. Subtract each creature's hit points from the total before moving on to the creature with the next lowest hit points. A creature's hit points must be equal to or less than the remaining total for that creature to be affected.

Undead and creatures immune to being charmed aren't affected by this spell.

At Higher Levels. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, roll an additional 2d8 for each slot level above 1st.
Sleep.materials: A pinch of fine sand, rose petals, or a cricket.

Detect Thoughts.name: Detect Thoughts
Detect Thoughts.description:
For the duration, you can read the thoughts of certain creatures. When you cast the spell and as your action on each turn until the spell ends, you can focus your mind on any one creature that you can see within 30 feet of you. If the creature you choose has an Intelligence of 3 or lower or doesn't speak any language, the creature is unaffected.

You initially learn the surface thoughts of the creature—what is most on its mind in that moment. As an action, you can either shift your attention to another creature's thoughts or attempt to probe deeper into the same creature's mind. If you probe deeper, the target must make a Wisdom saving throw. If it fails, you gain insight into its reasoning (if any), its emotional state, and something that looms large in its mind (such as something it worries over, loves, or hates). If it succeeds, the spell ends. Either way, the target knows that you are probing into its mind, and unless you shift your attention to another creature's thoughts, the creature can use its action on its turn to make an Intelligence check contested by your Intelligence check; if it succeeds, the spell ends.

Questions verbally directed at the target creature naturally shape the course of its thoughts, so this spell is particularly effective as part of an interrogation.

You can also use this spell to detect the presence of thinking creatures you can't see. When you cast the spell or as your action during the duration, you can search for thoughts within 30 feet of you. The spell can penetrate barriers, but 2 feet of rock, 2 inches of any metal other than lead, or a thin sheet of lead blocks you. You can't detect a creature with an Intelligence of 3 or lower or one that doesn't speak any language.

Once you detect the presence of a creature in this way, you can read its thoughts for the rest of the duration as described above, even if you can't see it, but it must still be within range.

Hold Person.name: Hold Person
Hold Person.description:
Choose a humanoid that you can see within range. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be paralyzed for the duration. At the end of each of its turns, the target can make another Wisdom saving throw. On a success, the spell ends on the target.

Higher Levels. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, you can target one additional humanoid for each slot level above 2nd. The humanoids must be within 30 feet of each other when you target them.
Hold Person.materials: A small, straight piece of iron

Lightning Bolt.name: Lightning Bolt
Lightning Bolt.description:
A stroke of lightning forming a line 100 feet long and 5 feet wide blasts out from you in a direction you choose. Each creature in the line must make a Dexterity saving throw. A creature takes 8d6 lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

The lightning ignites flammable objects in the area that aren't being worn or carried.

At Higher Levels. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the damage increases by 1d6 for each slot level above 3rd.
Lightning Bolt.materials: A bit of fur and a rod of amber, crystal, or glass

Water Breathing.name: Water Breathing
Water Breathing.description: This spell grants up to ten willing creatures you can see within range the ability to breathe underwater until the spell ends. Affected creatures also retain their normal mode of respiration.
Water Breathing.materials: A short reed or piece of straw

Blight.name: Blight
Blight.description:
Necromantic energy washes over a creature of your choice that you can see within range, draining moisture and vitality from it. The target must make a Constitution saving throw. The target takes 8d8 necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. This spell has no effect on undead or constructs.

If you target a plant creature or a magical plant, it makes the saving throw with disadvantage, and the spell deals maximum damage to it.

If you target a nonmagical plant that isn't a creature, such as a tree or shrub, it doesn't make a saving throw, it simply withers and dies.

At Higher Levels. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 5th level or higher, the damage increases by 1d8 for each slot level above 4th.

Dimension Door.name: Dimension Door
Dimension Door.description:
You teleport yourself from your current location to any other spot within range. You arrive at exactly the spot desired. It can be a place you can see, one you can visualize, or one you can describe by stating distance and direction, such as "200 feet straight downward" or "upward to the northwest at a 45-degree angle, 300 feet."

You can bring along objects as long as their weight doesn't exceed what you can carry. You can also bring one willing creature of your size or smaller who is carrying gear up to its carrying capacity. The creature must be within 5 feet of you when you cast this spell.

If you would arrive in a place already occupied by an object or a creature, you and any creature traveling with you each take 4d6 force damage, and the spell fails to teleport you.

Dominate Person.name: Dominate Person
Dominate Person.description:
You attempt to beguile a humanoid that you can see within range. It must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be charmed by you for the duration. If you or creatures that are friendly to you are fighting it, it has advantage on the saving throw.

While the target is charmed, you have a telepathic link with it as long as the two of you are on the same plane of existence. You can use this telepathic link to issue commands to the creature while you are conscious (no action required), which it does its best to obey. You can specify a simple and general course of action, such as "Attack that creature," "Run over there," or "Fetch that object." If the creature completes the order and doesn't receive further direction from you, it defends and preserves itself to the best of its ability.

You can use your action to take total and precise control of the target. Until the end of your next turn, the creature takes only the actions you choose, and doesn't do anything that you don't allow it to do. During this time you can also cause the creature to use a reaction, but this requires you to use your own reaction as well.

Each time the target takes damage, it makes a new Wisdom saving throw against the spell. If the saving throw succeeds, the spell ends.

At Higher Levels. When you cast this spell using a 6th-level spell slot, the duration is concentration, up to 10 minutes. When you use a 7th-level spell slot, the duration is concentration, up to 1 hour. When you use a spell slot of 8th level or higher, the duration is concentration, up to 8 hours.

Rejuvenation.name: Rejuvenation
Rejuvenation.description:
If it dies, the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} returns to life in 1d6 days and regains all its hit points.

Only a @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells.Item.3okM6Gn63zzEULkz]{Wish} spell can prevent this trait from functioning.
Rejuvenation.chat: If it dies, the [[lookup @name]]{monster} returns to life in 1d6 days and regains all its hit points.

Leather Armor (tiny).name: Leather Armor (tiny)
Leather Armor (tiny).description: The breastplate and shoulder protectors of this armor are made of leather that has been stiffened by being boiled in oil. The rest of the armor is made of softer and more flexible materials.

Shortbow.name: Shortbow
Shortbow.description: [[/attack extended]]. [[/damage extended]], and the target must succeed on a [[/save]] saving throw or become &Reference[poisoned] for [[lookup @labels.duration activity=vMfBrhdjnxaKy0Wn]]. If its saving throw result is 5 or lower, the poisoned target falls &Reference[unconscious] for the same duration, or until it takes damage or another creature takes an action to shake it awake.

save.condition: When a creature is hit by this attack.

Sprite's Sleeping Poison.name: Sprite's Sleeping Poison
Sprite's Sleeping Poison.description: You are &reference[poisoned apply=false] for the duration. While poisoned in this way, you fall &reference[unconscious apply=false] for the same duration, or until you take damage or another creature takes an action to shake you awake.

Invisibility.name: Invisibility
Invisibility.description: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} magically turns &reference[invisible] until it attacks or casts a spell, or until its concentration ends (as if concentrating on a spell). Any equipment the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} wears or carries is invisible with it.
Invisibility.chat: The sprite magically turns invisible. Any equipment the sprite wears or carries is invisible with it.

Invisibility.name: Invisibility
Invisibility.description: You are &reference[invisible] until you attack, cast a spell, or until your concentration ends (as if concentrating on a spell). Any equipment you are wearing or carrying is invisible as well.

Heart Sight.name: Heart Sight
Heart Sight.description:
The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} touches a creature and magically knows the creature's current emotional state.

If the target fails a [[/save]] saving throw, the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} also knows the creature's alignment. Celestials, fiends, and undead automatically fail the saving throw.
Heart Sight.chat: The sprite touches a creature. target must make a Charisma saving throw.

Cunning Action.name: Cunning Action
Cunning Action.description: On each of its turns, the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can use a bonus action to take the &reference[dash], &reference[disengage], or &reference[hide] action.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The spy makes two melee attacks.

Sneak Attack.name: Sneak Attack
Sneak Attack.description: Once per turn, the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} deals an extra [[/damage average]] damage when it hits a target with a weapon attack and has advantage on the attack roll, or when the target is within 5 feet of an ally of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} that isn't &reference[incapacitated apply=false] and the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} doesn't have disadvantage on the attack roll.

Bonus Damage.name: Bonus Damage
Bonus Damage.condition: When the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} hits a target with a weapon attack and has advantage on the attack roll, or when the target is within 5 feet of an ally of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} that isn't &reference[incapacitated apply=false] and the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} doesn't have disadvantage on the attack roll.

Death Burst.name: Death Burst
Death Burst.description: When the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} dies, it explodes in a cloud of steam. Each creature within [[lookup @target.template.size activity=g2aCIKzYHFlz8nUz]] feet of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} must succeed on a [[/save activity=g2aCIKzYHFlz8nUz]] saving throw or take [[/damage average activity=g2aCIKzYHFlz8nUz]] damage.
Death Burst.chat: When the [[lookup @name]]{monster} dies, it explodes in a cloud of steam. Each creature within [[lookup @target.template.size activity=g2aCIKzYHFlz8nUz]] feet of the [[lookup @name]]{monster} must make a Dexterity saving throw.

Innate Spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
Innate Spellcasting.description: The mephit can innately cast [[/item .UDUnlfPsOAbq2RSE]]{blur}, requiring no material components. Its innate spellcasting ability is Charisma.

Steam Breath.name: Steam Breath
Steam Breath.description: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} exhales a [[lookup @labels.description.template activity=oytDXenaNlnZuF5f]] of scalding steam. Each creature in that area must succeed on a [[/save activity=oytDXenaNlnZuF5f]] saving throw, taking [[/damage average activity=oytDXenaNlnZuF5f]] damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
Steam Breath.chat: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} exhales a [[lookup @labels.description.template activity=oytDXenaNlnZuF5f]] of scalding steam. Each creature in that area must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw.

Blur.name: Blur
Blur.description: Your body becomes blurred, shifting and wavering to all who can see you. For the duration, any creature has disadvantage on attack rolls against you. An attacker is immune to this effect if it doesn't rely on sight, as with blindsight, or can see through illusions, as with truesight.

Blood Drain.name: Blood Drain
Blood Drain.description:
[[/attack extended]]. [[/damage extended]].

The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} attaches to the target. While attached, the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} doesn't attack. Instead, at the start of each of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s turns, the target loses 5 (1d4 + 3) hit points due to blood loss.The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can detach itself by spending 5 feet of its movement. It does so after it drains 10 hit points of blood from the target or the target dies.
Blood Drain.chat: The [[lookup @name]]{monster} attacks with its [[lookup @item.name]]. A creature, including the target, can use its action to detach the stirge.

Drain Blood (While Attached).name: Drain Blood (While Attached)
Drain Blood (While Attached).condition: While the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} is attached to a creature.

Attached Stirge.name: Attached Stirge
Attached Stirge.description: The stirge has attached itself to you, draining you of blood.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} makes two [[/item .Tm2NY0eSI6InRcsa]]{greatclub} attacks.

Rock.name: Rock
Rock.description:
[[/attack extended]]. [[/damage extended]].

If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a [[/save activity=GOn2YYbOxKVKqvwx]] saving throw or be knocked &reference[prone].
Rock.chat: The [[lookup @name]]{monster} attacks with its [[lookup @item.name]]. If the target is a creature, it must make a Strength saving throw or be knocked &reference[prone].

Prone Save.name: Prone Save
Prone Save.condition: When a creature is hit by this attack.

Rock Catching.name: Rock Catching
Rock Catching.description: If a rock or similar object is hurled at the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}, the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can, with a successful [[/save]] saving throw, catch the missile and take no bludgeoning damage from it.
Rock Catching.chat: If a rock or similar object is hurled at the giant, the giant can catch the missile and take no bludgeoning damage from it.

Catch Rock.name: Catch Rock
Catch Rock.condition: When a rock or similar object is hurled at the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}.

Stone Camouflage.name: Stone Camouflage
Stone Camouflage.description: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to &reference[hide] in rocky terrain.

Stone Golem.name: Stone Golem
Stone Golem.languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} makes two [[/item .DelAxHnRbNHC6OoV]]{slam} attacks.

Slam.name: Slam
Slam.chat: The Stone Golem attacks with its Slam.

Slow.name: Slow
Slow.description:
The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} targets one or more creatures it can see within [[lookup @labels.description.range activity=o1gVWezg9dluEi5a]] of it. Each target must make a [[/save]] saving throw against this magic.

On a failed save, a target can't use reactions, its speed is halved, and it can't make more than one attack on its turn. In addition, the target can take either an action or a bonus action on its turn, not both. These effects last for [[lookup @labels.duration activity=o1gVWezg9dluEi5a]]. A target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.
Slow.chat: The [[lookup @name]]{monster} targets one or more creatures it can see within [[lookup @labels.description.range activity=o1gVWezg9dluEi5a]] of it. Each target must make a Wisdom saving throw against this magic. A target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

Slowed.name: Slowed
Slowed.description:
Your speed is halved, take a -2 penalty to AC and Dexterity saving throws, and you can't use reactions. On your turn, you can use either an action or a bonus action, not both.

You can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of your turns, ending the effect on yourself on a success.

Immutable Form.name: Immutable Form
Immutable Form.description: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

Magic Resistance.name: Magic Resistance
Magic Resistance.description: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

Scale Mail.name: Scale Mail
Scale Mail.description: This armor consists of a coat and leggings (and perhaps a separate skirt) of leather covered with overlapping pieces of metal, much like the scales of a fish. The suit includes gauntlets.

Innate Spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
Innate Spellcasting.description:
The giant's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 17). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

At will: [[/item .ghXTfe7sgCbgf1Q8]]{detect magic}, [[/item .pub0OWVEB71XQx1n]]{feather fall}, [[/item .MRxldJd6C4bsBo3O]]{levitate}, [[/item .Bnn9Nzajixvow9xi]]{light}

3/day each: [[/item .ZPd73HtKF3At11jh]]{control weather}, [[/item .13uVuBQP6VaiSPvC]]{water breathing}

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The giant makes two [[/item .iwN0z7f5LF9AAbRJ]]{greatsword} attacks.

Detect Magic.name: Detect Magic
Detect Magic.description:
For the duration, you sense the presence of magic within 30 feet of you. If you sense magic in this way, you can use your action to see a faint aura around any visible creature or object in the area that bears magic, and you learn its school of magic, if any.

The spell can penetrate most barriers, but it is blocked by 1 foot of stone, 1 inch of common metal, a thin sheet of lead, or 3 feet of wood or dirt.

Feather Fall.name: Feather Fall
Feather Fall.description: Choose up to five falling creatures within range. A falling creature's rate of descent slows to 60 feet per round until the spell ends. If the creature lands before the spell ends, it takes no falling damage and can land on its feet, and the spell ends for that creature.
Feather Fall.materials: A small feather or piece of down
Feather Fall.condition: which you take when you or a creature within 60 feet of you falls

Levitate.name: Levitate
Levitate.description:
One creature or object of your choice that you can see within range rises vertically, up to 20 feet, and remains suspended there for the duration. The spell can levitate a target that weighs up to 500 pounds. An unwilling creature that succeeds on a Constitution saving throw is unaffected.

The target can move only by pushing or pulling against a fixed object or surface within reach (such as a wall or a ceiling), which allows it to move as if it were climbing. You can change the target's altitude by up to 20 feet in either direction on your turn. If you are the target, you can move up or down as part of your move. Otherwise, you can use your action to move the target, which must remain within the spell's range.

When the spell ends, the target floats gently to the ground if it is still aloft.
Levitate.materials: Either a small leather loop or a piece of golden wire bent into a cup shape with a long shank on one end

Light.name: Light
Light.description:
You touch one object that is no larger than 10 feet in any dimension. Until the spell ends, the object sheds bright light in a 20-foot radius and dim light for an additional 20 feet. The light can be colored as you like. Completely covering the object with something opaque blocks the light. The spell ends if you cast it again or dismiss it as an action.

If you target an object held or worn by a hostile creature, that creature must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw to avoid the spell.

Control Weather.name: Control Weather
Control Weather.description:
You take control of the weather within 5 miles of you for the duration. You must be outdoors to cast this spell. Moving to a place where you don't have a clear path to the sky ends the spell early.

When you cast the spell, you change the current weather conditions, which are determined by the DM based on the climate and season. You can change precipitation, temperature, and wind. It takes 1d4 x 10 minutes for the new conditions to take effect. Once they do so, you can change the conditions again. When the spell ends, the weather gradually returns to normal.

When you change the weather conditions, find a current condition on the following tables and change its stage by one, up or down. When changing the wind, you can change its direction.

Conditions

  1. Clear
  2. Light clouds
  3. Overcast or ground fog
  4. Rain, hail, or snow
  5. Torrential rain, driving hail, or blizzard

Temperature

  1. Unbearable heat
  2. Hot
  3. Warm
  4. Cool
  5. Cold
  6. Arctic cold

Wind

  1. Calm
  2. Moderate wind
  3. Strong wind
  4. Gale
  5. Storm
Control Weather.materials: Burning incense and bits of earth and wood mixed in water.

Water Breathing.name: Water Breathing
Water Breathing.description: This spell grants up to ten willing creatures you can see within range the ability to breathe underwater until the spell ends. Affected creatures also retain their normal mode of respiration.
Water Breathing.materials: A short reed or piece of straw

Lightning Strike.name: Lightning Strike
Lightning Strike.description:
The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} hurls a magical lightning bolt at a point it can see within [[lookup @labels.description.range activity=Y2GMAvtp4yB0QcvH]] of it.

Each creature within [[lookup @target.template.size activity=Y2GMAvtp4yB0QcvH]] feet of that point must make a [[/save]] saving throw, taking [[/damage average]] damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
Lightning Strike.chat: The [[lookup @name]]{monster} attacks with its [[lookup @item.name]]. Each creature within [[lookup @target.template.size activity=Y2GMAvtp4yB0QcvH]] feet of that point must make a Dexterity saving throw.

Amphibious.name: Amphibious
Amphibious.description: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can breathe air and water.

Telepathic Bond.name: Telepathic Bond
Telepathic Bond.description: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} ignores the range restriction on its telepathy when communicating with a creature it has &reference[charmed apply=false]. The two don't even need to be on the same plane of existence.

Shapechanger.name: Shapechanger
Shapechanger.description:
The [[lookup @details.type.value]]{monster} can use its action to polymorph into a Small or Medium humanoid, or back into its true form. Without wings, the [[lookup @details.type.value]]{monster} loses its flying speed. Other than its size and speed, its statistics are the same in each form.

Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies.
Shapechanger.chat: The fiend can use its action to polymorph into a humanoid, or back into its true form.

Charm.name: Charm
Charm.description:
One humanoid the [[lookup @details.type.value]]{monster} can see within [[lookup @labels.description.range activity=ZFCUDfqONxiB5KBa]] of it must make a [[/save]] saving throw or be magically &reference[charmed apply=false] for [[lookup @labels.duration activity=ZFCUDfqONxiB5KBa]]. The charmed target obeys the [[lookup @details.type.value]]{monster}'s verbal or telepathic commands.

If the target suffers any harm or receives a suicidal command, it can repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on a success. If the target successfully saves against the effect, or if the effect on it ends, the target is immune to this [[lookup @details.type.value]]{monster}'s [[lookup @item.name]] for the next 24 hours.The [[lookup @details.type.value]]{monster} can have only one target charmed at a time. If it charms another, the effect on the previous target ends.
Charm.chat: One humanoid the fiend can see within 30 feet of it must make a Wisdom saving throw.

Charmed.name: Charmed
Charmed.description:
You are &reference[charmed apply=false] and obey the fiend's verbal or telepathic commands.

If you suffer any harm or recieve a suicidal command, you can repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on a success.

Draining Kiss.name: Draining Kiss
Draining Kiss.description:
The [[lookup @details.type.value]]{monster} kisses a &reference[charmed apply=false] charmed by it or a willing creature. The target must make a [[/save activity=hczxJO21CcoyyyO7]] saving throw against this magic, taking [[/damage activity=hczxJO21CcoyyyO7]] damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

The target's hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the damage taken. This reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target dies if this effect reduces its hit point maximum to 0.

Foundry Note

You can use the "Maximum Hit Point Damage" activity to input the amount of damage a creature took from this attack and reduce their hit point maximum by that amount.
Draining Kiss.chat: The target must make a Constitution saving throw against this magic.

Maximum Hit Point Damage.name: Maximum Hit Point Damage
Maximum Hit Point Damage.condition: When a creature takes damage from this feature.

Etherealness.name: Etherealness
Etherealness.description: The [[lookup @details.type.value]]{monster} magically enters the Ethereal Plane from the Material Plane, or vice versa.

Bites.description: Melee Weapon Attack: [[/attack]], 0 ft., one creature in the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{swarm}'s space. Hit: [[/damage 2d4 piercing average]] damage, or [[/damage 1d4 piercing average]] damage if the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{swarm} has half of its hit points or fewer.

Reflective Carapace.name: Reflective Carapace
Reflective Carapace.description:
Any time the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} is targeted by a @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells.Item.41JIhpDyM9Anm7cs]{magic missile} spell, a line spell, or a spell that requires a ranged attack roll, roll a d6. On a 1 to 5, the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} is unaffected.

On a 6, the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} is unaffected, and the effect is reflected back at the caster as though it originated from the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}, turning the caster into the target.
Reflective Carapace.chat: The tarrasque is unaffected, and the effect is reflected back at the caster as though it originated from the tarrasque, turning the caster into the target.

Magic Resistance.description: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

Persevere.name: Persevere
Persevere.condition: When the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} fails a saving throw.

Siege Monster.name: Siege Monster
Siege Monster.description: The [[lookup @details.type.config.label lowercase]]{monster} deals double damage to objects and structures.

Frightful Presence.name: Frightful Presence
Frightful Presence.description:
Each creature of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s choice that is within [[lookup @labels.description.range activity=2VOmvThI0bGdUsMt]] of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} and aware of it must succeed on a [[/save]] saving throw or become &Reference[frightened] for [[lookup @labels.duration activity=2VOmvThI0bGdUsMt]].

A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s [[lookup @item.name]] for the next 24 hours.
Frightful Presence.chat: Each creature of the [[lookup @name]]{monster}'s choice that is within [[lookup @labels.description.range activity=2VOmvThI0bGdUsMt]] of the [[lookup @name]]{monster} and aware of it must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns.

Frightful Presence.name: Frightful Presence
Frightful Presence.description:
You are &reference[frightened apply=false] for 1 minute.

You can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of your turns, ending the effect on yourself on a success. If your saving throw is successful or the effect ends for you, you are immune to the tarrasque's Frightful Presence for the next 24 hours.

Swallow.name: Swallow
Swallow.description:
The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} makes one [[/item .suUr7bJqBqE7xk2F]]{Bite} attack against a Medium or smaller target it is &reference[grappling]. If the attack hits, the target is also swallowed, and the grapple ends. While swallowed, the target is &reference[blinded] and &reference[restrained], it has &reference[total cover] against attacks and other effects outside the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}, and it takes [[/damage average activity=JiBTCgEtAZs60k7R]] damage at the start of each of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s turns. A [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can have only one creature swallowed at a time.

If the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} takes 30 damage or more on a single turn from the swallowed creature, the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} must succeed on a [[/save activity=2pCVkETAYg7qALRu]] saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate the creature, which falls prone in a space within 10 feet of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}. If the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} dies, a swallowed creature is no longer restrained by it and can escape from the corpse by using 15 feet of movement, exiting &reference[prone].

Start of Turn Digestion Damage.name: Start of Turn Digestion Damage
Start of Turn Digestion Damage.condition: When the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} starts its turn while it has a creature swallowed.

Swallow Creature.name: Swallow Creature
Swallow Creature.condition: When the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} hits a creature it has &reference[grappled apply=false] with its @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.monsters.Actor.x47ZnpHfYl0ptDM9.Item.4fNbTxkAFYHxDdJX]{Bite}.

Regurgitate Creature Save.name: Regurgitate Creature Save
Regurgitate Creature Save.condition: When the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} takes 60 or more damage on a single turn form a swallowed creature.

Swallowed.name: Swallowed
Swallowed.description:
You have been swallowed by the tarrasque. You are &reference[blinded apply=false], &reference[restrained apply=false], and have &reference[total cover] against attacks and other effects outsdie the tarrasque.

You also take [[/damage average 16d6 acid]] damage at the start of each of the tarrasque's turns.

If the tarrasque takes 60 damage or more on a single turn from you, the tarrasque must succceed on a Constitution saving throw or regurgitate you, causing you to fall &reference[prone] in a space within 10 feet of the tarrasque. If the tarrasque dies, you are no longer restrained by it and can escape from the corpse by using 30 feet of movement, exiting &reference[prone].

The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} magically animates one or two trees it can see within [[lookup @labels.description.range activity=1SrLlYGeLgzdmSwc]] of it. These trees have the same statistics as a [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}, except they have Intelligence and Charisma scores of 1, they can't speak, and they have only the @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.monsters.Actor.NB6wUgVqeOQtsQKu.Item.lisZZTaupqInGEi1]{slam} action option.

An animated tree acts as an ally of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}. The tree remains animate for [[lookup @labels.duration activity=1SrLlYGeLgzdmSwc]] or until it dies; until the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} dies or is more than 120 feet from the tree; or until the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} takes a bonus action to turn it back into an inanimate tree. The tree then takes root if possible.
Animate Trees.chat: The [[lookup @name]]{monster} magically animates one or two trees it can see within [[lookup @labels.description.range activity=1SrLlYGeLgzdmSwc]] of it.

Animated Tree.name: Animated Tree
Animated Tree.description:
You have the same statistics as a treant, except you have an Intelligence and Charisma score of 1, you can't speak, and you only have the Slam action option.

You act as an ally of the treant. You remain animate for 1 day or until you die; until the treant dies or is more than 120 feet from you; or until the treant takes a bonus action to turn you back into an inanimate tree. You then take root if possible.

At will: [[/item .Mzh95utKDPIrjiH8]]{detect evil and good}, [[/item .SbSvZKkJASyk8jKo]]{druidcraft}, [[/item .pRMvmknwLf2tdMTj]]{pass without trace}

1/day each: [[/item .3MYDjS6k9IYL0aTj]]{calm emotions}, [[/item .TkJ8Wtg1L7TZtspm]]{dispel evil and good}, [[/item .gMrWeG8fMDPRFiVe]]{entangle}

Multiattack.description: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} makes two attacks: one with its [[/item .f7m44y4TqYYcunMj]]{hooves} and one with its [[/item .ORrGdhTLKLTKK3BH]]{horn}.

Teleport.name: Teleport
Teleport.description: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} magically teleports itself and up to [[lookup @labels.description.affects activity=8owft3XymVhz240J]] it can see within 5 feet of it, along with any equipment they are wearing or carrying, to a location the unicorn is familiar with, up to [[lookup @labels.description.range activity=8owft3XymVhz240J]] away.
Teleport.chat: The unicorn magically teleports itself and up to three willing creatures it can see within 5 ft. of it, along with any equipment they are wearing or carrying, to a location the unicorn is familiar with, up to 1 mile away.

UNbcqlW8Siek0Fpm.name: Hooves
UNbcqlW8Siek0Fpm.description: The unicorn makes one attack with its [[/item .f7m44y4TqYYcunMj]]{hooves}.

Shimmering Shield.name: Shimmering Shield
Shimmering Shield.description: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} creates a shimmering, magical field around itself or another creature it can see within [[lookup @labels.description.range activity=dnd5eactivity000]] of it. The target gains a +2 bonus to AC until the end of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s next turn.

Ward Creature.name: Ward Creature
Ward Creature.description: A shimmering, magical field has manifested around you. You gain a +2 bonus to AC until the end of the unicorn's next turn.

Detect Evil and Good.name: Detect Evil and Good
Detect Evil and Good.description:
For the duration, you know if there is an aberration, celestial, elemental, fey, fiend, or undead within 30 feet of you, as well as where the creature is located. Similarly, you know if there is a place or object within 30 feet of you that has been magically consecrated or desecrated.

The spell can penetrate most barriers, but it is blocked by 1 foot of stone, 1 inch of common metal, a thin sheet of lead, or 3 feet of wood or dirt.

Druidcraft.name: Druidcraft
Druidcraft.description:
Whispering to the spirits of Nature, you create one of the following Effects within range:

  • You create a tiny, harmless sensory effect that predicts what the weather will be at your location for the next 24 hours. The effect might manifest as a golden orb for clear skies, a cloud for rain, Falling snowflakes for snow, and so on. This effect persists for 1 round.
  • You instantly make a flower blossom, a seed pod open, or a leaf bud bloom.
  • You create an Instantaneous, harmless sensory effect, such as Falling leaves, a puff of wind, the sound of a small animal, or the faint odor of skunk. The effect must fit in a 5-foot cube.
  • You instantly light or snuff out a Candle, a torch, or a small campfire.

Pass without Trace.name: Pass without Trace
Pass without Trace.description: A veil of shadows and Silence radiates from you, masking you and your companions from detection. For the Duration, each creature you choose within 30 feet of you (including you) has a +10 bonus to Dexterity (Stealth) checks and can't be tracked except by magical means. A creature that receives this bonus leaves behind no tracks or other traces of its passage.
Pass without Trace.materials: Ashes from a burned leaf of mistletoe and a sprig of spruce

Calm Emotions.name: Calm Emotions
Calm Emotions.description:
You attempt to suppress strong emotions in a group of people. Each humanoid in a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on a point you choose within range must make a Charisma saving throw; a creature can choose to fail this saving throw if it wishes. If a creature fails its saving throw, choose one of the following two effects. You can suppress any effect causing a target to be charmed or frightened. When this spell ends, any suppressed effect resumes, provided that its duration has not expired in the meantime.

Alternatively, you can make a target indifferent about creatures of your choice that it is hostile toward. This indifference ends if the target is attacked or harmed by a spell or if it witnesses any of its friends being harmed. When the spell ends, the creature becomes hostile again, unless the DM rules otherwise.

Dispel Evil and Good.name: Dispel Evil and Good
Dispel Evil and Good.description:
Shimmering energy surrounds and protects you from fey, Undead, and creatures originating from Beyond the Material Plane. For the Duration, Celestials, Elementals, fey, Fiends, and undead have disadvantage on Attack rolls against you.

You can end the spell early by using either of the following special functions.

Break Enchantment. As your action, you touch a creature you can reach that is Charmed, Frightened, or possessed by a Celestial, an elemental, a fey, a fiend, or an Undead. The creature you touch is no longer charmed, frightened, or possessed by such creatures.

Dismissal. As your action, make a melee spell Attack against a Celestial, an elemental, a fey, a fiend, or an Undead you can reach. On a hit, you attempt to drive the creature back to its home plane. The creature must succeed on a Charisma saving throw or be sent back to its home plane (if it isn't there already). If they aren't on their home plane, undead are sent to the Shadowfell, and fey are sent to the Feywild.

Entangle.name: Entangle
Entangle.description:
Grasping weeds and vines sprout from the ground in a 20-foot square starting from a point within range. For the Duration, these Plants turn the ground in the area into difficult terrain.

A creature in the area when you cast the spell must succeed on a Strength saving throw or be Restrained by the entangling Plants until the spell ends. A creature restrained by the plants can use its action to make a Strength check against your spell save DC. On a success, it frees itself.

When the spell ends, the conjured Plants wilt away.

Invisible.name: Invisible
Invisible.description:
• An invisible creature is impossible to see without the aid of magic or a special sense. For the purpose of hiding, the creature is heavily obscured. The creature's location can be detected by any noise it makes or any tracks it leaves.
  • Attack rolls against the creature have disadvantage, and the creature's attack rolls have advantage.

Vampire.languages: the languages it knew in life

Shapechanger.name: Shapechanger
Shapechanger.description:
If the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} isn't in sun light or running water, it can use its action to polymorph into a Tiny bat or a Medium cloud of mist, or back into its true form.

While in bat form, the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can't speak, its walking speed is 5 feet, and it has a flying speed of 30 feet. Its statistics, other than its size and speed, are unchanged. Anything it is wearing transforms with it, but nothing it is carrying does. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

While in mist form, the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can't take any actions, speak, or manipulate objects. It is weightless, has a flying speed of 20 feet, can hover, and can enter a hostile creature's space and stop there. In addition, if air can pass through a space, the mist can do so without &reference[squeezing]{Squeezing}, and it can't pass through water. It has advantage on Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution saving throws, and it is immune to all nonmagical damage, except the damage it takes from sunlight.
Shapechanger.chat: The [[lookup @name]]{monster} can use its action to polymorph or return to its true form.

Misty Escape.name: Misty Escape
Misty Escape.description:
When it drops to 0 hit points outside its resting place, the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} transforms into a cloud of mist (as in the @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.monsters.Actor.DDO9lDCDtNHkfShP.Item.BqG5guVa93LaOAn1]{Shapechanger} trait) instead of falling &reference[unconscious apply=false], provided that it isn't in sunlight or running water. If it can't transform, it is destroyed.

While it has 0 hit points in mist form, it can't revert to its [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} form, and it must reach its resting place within 2 hours or be destroyed. Once in its resting place, it reverts to its [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} form. It is then &reference[paralyzed] until it regains at least 1 hit point. After spending 1 hour in its resting place with 0 hit points, it regains 1 hit point.

The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} targets one humanoid it can see within [[lookup @labels.description.range activity=kzseXOAXwSg10knT]] of it. If the target can see the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}, the target must succeed on a [[/save]] saving throw against this magic or be &reference[charmed] by the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}. The charmed target regards the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} as a trusted friend to be heeded and protected. Although the target isn't under the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s control, it takes the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s requests or actions in the most favorable way it can, and it is a willing target for the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.monsters.Actor.DDO9lDCDtNHkfShP.Item.uqHuj7Pjf2sjny21]{bite} attack.

Each time the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} or the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s companions do anything harmful to the target, it can repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success. Otherwise, the effect lasts 24 hours or until the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} is destroyed, is on a different plane of existence than the target, or takes a bonus action to end the effect.

Each time the vampire or the vampire's companions do anything harmful to you, you can repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on yourself on a success.
